name: git-prism
description: IDE-style Git log for VS Code: branches tree, commit graph with stable ordering and lane colors, changed files per commit, and a full set of Git actions (compare, history, blame, rebase, merge, conflicts, stash) in the editor menu.

commands.title: Extract Selected Changes to Separate Commit…
Extract Selected Changes to Separate Commit…
Open New Git Log Editor Tab
Show Diff in a New Tab
Extract Selected Changes to Separate Commit…
Navigate Log to Selected Branch Head

gitPrism.gitPath.description: Path to the git executable. Empty uses `git` from PATH.

gitPrism.annotate.showRevision.description: Annotations: show the short commit hash (Revision).

gitPrism.annotate.names.description: Annotations: how author names are shown.

enumDescriptions: Color by commit age: recent commits are more saturated
git blame -M: lines moved or copied within the file
git blame -C: also lines moved or copied from other files of the same commit
gitPrism.annotate.detectMovements.description: Annotations: detect moved or copied lines.

gitPrism.annotate.preferCommitTimestamp.description: Annotations: show the commit timestamp instead of the author timestamp.

gitPrism.branches.showTags.description: Branches popup: show the Tags section.

gitPrism.branches.showRecent.description: Branches popup: show recently checked out branches.

gitPrism.branches.groupByDirectory.description: Branches popup: group branches by their '/' prefix.

gitPrism.branches.groupByRepository.description: Branches popup: show branches per repository when the workspace has several repositories.

gitPrism.branches.showOnlyFavorites.description: Branches popup: show only favorite branches.

gitPrism.cherryPick.addSuffix.description: Add the 'cherry-picked from <hash>' suffix when picking commits pushed to protected branches (gitPrism.push.protectedBranches)

gitPrism.commitOps.showDropCommitDialog.description: Show the confirmation dialog before Drop Commits (unset by "OK, Don't Ask Again"). Protected branches for history editing are the ones of gitPrism.push.protectedBranches.

gitPrism.conflicts.showNotification.description: Show a "Merge Conflicts" notification with "Resolve…" when unmerged files appear in a repository.

gitPrism.diff.gutterMarkers.description: Highlight modified lines in the gutter (added, modified and deleted lines against HEAD) and in the overview ruler. Consider setting `scm.diffDecorations` to `none` to avoid duplicate markers.

enumDescriptions: Topologically: in case of merge, show incoming commits first, directly below merge commit
By Commit Date: sort commits topologically and by commit date

gitPrism.log.firstParent.description: Git Log: First Parent — follow only the first parent commit upon seeing a merge commit.

gitPrism.log.showLongEdges.description: Git Log: Long Edges — show long graph edges instead of cutting them behind arrows.

gitPrism.log.columns.description: Git Log: visible columns in display order (subject holds the graph and references).

gitPrism.log.preferCommitDate.description: Git Log: Commit Timestamp — show the time when the change was committed rather than authored.

gitPrism.log.dateFormat.description: Git Log: date format pattern (yyyy, yy, MM, M, dd, d, HH, H, mm, ss). Empty uses the locale format.

gitPrism.log.prettyDates.description: Git Log: show recent dates as Today / Yesterday.

gitPrism.log.showTagNames.description: Git Log: Tag Names — show tag names in the table.

gitPrism.log.compactReferences.description: Git Log: Compact References View — show only the first reference for a commit in the table.

gitPrism.log.referencesOnLeft.description: Git Log: References on the Left — show references on the left of commit message.

gitPrism.log.showDetails.description: Git Log: Show Details — commit details below the changed files.

gitPrism.log.showBranches.description: Git Log: show the branches tree on the left of the log.

gitPrism.push.protectedBranches.description: Protected branches (comma-separated regular expressions). Force Push to them is prohibited.

gitPrism.fetch.prune.description: Prune obsolete remote-tracking references when fetching (--prune).

gitPrism.update.showDialog.description: Show the Update Project dialog before updating (uncheck "Don't show this dialog again" there to bring it back).

enumDescriptions: Merge incoming changes into the current branch
Rebase the current branch on top of incoming changes
gitPrism.update.method.description: Update method of Update Project and of updating after a rejected push.

enumDescriptions: Using Shelve (mapped to stash in VS Code)

editor/lineNumber/context.when: !(resourcePath in gitPrism.annotate.paths) && (resourceScheme == file || resourceScheme == gitprism-rev || resourceScheme == gitprism-annotate)

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run contributes && npm run typecheck && npm run build
